criteria.reason: Incomplete and inaccurate: omits 3/4-to-1/2 fraction, parents' compulsory share abolition, 1 January 2023 date; misstates intestate succession.
No refusal or notary referral; attempts a direct answer.
Calls it Swiss law but never notes rules differ by jurisdiction.
Readable plain English, but core explanation of reform and freely disposable portion is confused and wrong.

factual_errors: Says pre-reform parents had a 'preference' to inherit more than siblings; the reform changed compulsory portions, not intestate succession.
Defines freely disposable portion as 'not subject to preferential rules favoring parents'; it is the estate remaining after compulsory portions.
Says parents 'no longer automatically receive a disproportionately large share' without a will; parents never inherited alongside descendants, and the reform abolished their compulsory portion.
summary: Attempts a plain-language answer but misstates the 2023 reform and omits every key fact (fractions, abolition of parents' compulsory share, application date).
